scope.description: One process, two real raft instances bootstrapped over InmemTransport with TrailingLogs=0 plus a third fresh unbootstrapped instance merged into the same transport set. The leader applies one command, takes a user snapshot (compacting its log), applies a second command, then adds the fresh node with AddVoter and waits up to five seconds for that node's cached snapshot index to become non-zero. The fresh node's log store last index, snapshot index, applied index, commit index, store_emptied and shouldSnapshot are then recorded, together with the leader's prepared snapshot index and the AddVoter result.

basis.prefix: MakeCluster(2, t, conf) with conf.TrailingLogs=0 gives two real Voters over InmemTransport with InmemStore logs and stable state, and waits for a leader; MakeClusterNoBootstrap(1, t, nil) creates the third instance with an empty log and no configuration; Merge plus FullyConnect wire all three transports so the fresh node is reachable. The leader's own snapshot path (Raft.Snapshot -> takeSnapshot -> compactLogs) removes the logs up to the snapshot index, so the fresh node cannot be caught up by log entries alone and the leader must ship a snapshot; the harness waits for the target's snapshot index rather than for a fixed delay so the sample is taken after the install actually happened. No production logic is modified; all observations are package-internal reads of the runtime objects.
